title: What the override record says when an allowed-once edit never lands
context: After someone picks Allow once in the HUD, the edit can still not happen: they say no in Claude Code's own approval box, or something else (their own settings, another tool, their organization, a second paqad rule) still stops it. The override line in rule-overrides.jsonl is written before that final answer, so today it can read as an edit that ran. Reviewers read these records as proof of what happened. Grounded in docs/modules/feature-evidence/features/rule-override/business.md.
